description: This file implements the ConditionService interface for managing medical conditions within the OpenMRS system. It provides methods to retrieve, save, void, unvoid, and delete condition objects, handling interactions with the underlying data access layer (ConditionDAO) and managing versioning and state changes of condition entities.

classes.name: ConditionServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ConditionService interface that manages 'Condition' entities, providing CRUD operations, versioning, and voiding/unvoiding capabilities within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: setConditionDAO
methods.description: Setter for dependency injection of the ConditionDAO.

methods.name: getConditionByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Condition by its UUID, read-only transaction.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Retrieves a Condition by its internal ID, read-only transaction.

methods.name: getActiveConditions
methods.description: Fetches a list of active conditions for a given patient, read-only transaction.

methods.name: getAllConditions
methods.description: Fetches all conditions for a patient, read-only transaction.

methods.name: getConditionsByEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves conditions related to a specific encounter, may throw APIException.

methods.name: saveCondition
methods.description: Saves or updates a condition, handles versioning and voiding logic.

methods.name: voidCondition
methods.description: Voids a condition with a specified reason after validation.

methods.name: purseCondition
methods.description: Removes a condition from the database (use with caution).
